snippet.title: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth – Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on Steam → https://store.steampowered.com/app/4522210/Junkyard_Stories_Rebirth/

Junkyard Stories: Rebirth is a dystopian sci-fi adventure where you play as a discarded robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker.

Cross wastelands, scavenge for resources, hack systems, and solve environmental puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate BLOCK-07 and find the one person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

Part of the Junkyard Stories universe © 2026 Nandor’s Lab Ltd. All rights reserved.

—

ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS

Junkyard Stories: Rebirth is an independent project developed through a collaboration between two developers: Nandor’s Lab Ltd. and Greenworks Productions Srl.

IP Owner & Creator: Nandor’s Lab Ltd.
(worldbuilding and visual production)

Development & Publishing: Greenworks Productions Srl.
(programming and technical implementation)

—

Follow the project:
Website → https://www.junkyardstories.com/
Instagram → https://www.instagram.com/junkyardstories.world/
X → https://x.com/junkyardstories
ArtStation → https://www.artstation.com/junkyardstories
